summary: Markdown applies a GitHub-like HTML policy on parsed and plain fallback paths: hidden content stays hidden, raw pre/code retains its words, allowed elements render, details disclose, links allow http(s) and document references, images wait for consent, and nesting is capped at 32

replay.detail: Web UI only; no replay or rebuild.

compatibility.detail: Web UI only; no wire, protocol, runtime or client changes.
